lines.text: Many learners say: I am interested with music.
Better: I am interested in music.
In! I am interested in art.

native.tip: Kita bilang “tertarik pada musik” atau “tertarik dengan”. Di bahasa Inggris, setelah interested pakai in.
native.caption: Pernah bilang begini? “I am interested with music.” 😅 Setelah interested, pakai in: “I am interested in music.” Dengarkan Kak Carlos, lalu ulangi! Latihan lagi di app Lexkite.
native.comment: Jawaban: “in”. Ucapkan dengan lantang: “I am interested in music.” lalu tulis satu hal yang kamu minati. Latihan gratis lainnya di sini: {link}

en.tip: We say “tertarik pada musik”. In English, after interested use in.
en.caption: Ever say this? “I am interested with music.” 😅 After interested, use in: “I am interested in music.” Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
